audit.why: 50.42% over ~1200 games at EVEN 6/10 is right: Olaf owns levels 1-5, Ornn owns full build.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Olaf, Skill, Olaf. That gives Olaf the 2+ items row on a champion the same page describes as a near-unkillable Brittle-applying frontline whose true damage 'no longer dents him', and calls levels 4-5 a coin flip when the why beneath says Olaf wins every short trade while Ornn only last-hits.
audit.why: Ornn has no sustain and no dash and cannot contest levels 1-5; his self-forged HP and armour reverse the matchup at two items. The packet chart and the existing whys agree with each other and both disagreed with the sides.
audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Ornn, with ratings moved on the three rows that changed hands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (1) Slot error repeated five times across the content layer: the magma pillar is called 'W-pillar'. Volcanic Rupture (Q) creates the pillar; Bellows Breath (W) is the fire breath that applies Brittle; Searing Charge (E) is the charge that only knocks up when it collides with terrain. The page also credits Brittle to 'E/auto' when Brittle comes from W and R. (2) The full layer says 'R cleanses it' about Volcanic Rupture and the content layer says Ragnarok 'strips his E-knockup, W-pillar and R double-knockup'.
audit.why: The slot error breaks the actual counterplay, which is terrain-based: Searing Charge is harmless in open lane and lethal against a wall or against the pillar Volcanic Rupture just made. A player told to bait the 'W-pillar' watches the wrong bar. On the second point, Riot's Ragnarok text is 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking' — that is conditional immunity, not a cleanse, and whether it covers knockup displacement is not stated anywhere in the kit files.
audit.corrected: Pillar re-attributed to Volcanic Rupture (9s at rank 1, 800 range) everywhere, Searing Charge given its 14s and its terrain condition, Brittle attributed to Bellows Breath. The counterplay rewritten as 'fight in open lane, away from his pillar'. Ragnarok described as disable immunity held while attacking, with no knockup claim asserted in either direction.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers; 'track Volcanic Rupture' repeated eight times with no duration and no statement of why it matters.
audit.why: Searing Charge at 14s rank 1 is the punishable one — it is his only engage and it needs terrain. Volcanic Rupture at 9s comes back too fast to plan around, but its pillar is what makes Searing Charge work.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into the cooldown breakdown and the all-in window, with the terrain dependency stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannot verify whether Ragnarok's disable immunity covers the airborne from Searing Charge or Call of the Forge God.
audit.why: Riot's text does not separate displacement from disable and needsResearch is empty by design.
audit.corrected: Removed the claim that Ragnarok strips his knockups; asserted nothing in its place. See unverified.

notes: PACKET DEFECT: brief top-level games is 1208, packet.games is 1194 — audited as a live matchup either way. The dominant error was slot confusion: the magma pillar was called the 'W-pillar' in five places across the content layer. Volcanic Rupture (Q) makes the pillar, Bellows Breath (W) applies Brittle, Searing Charge (E) only knocks up on terrain collision. That matters because the real counterplay is positional — fight in open lane and Searing Charge has nothing to hit. I also removed the claim that Ragnarok strips his knockups: Riot's text says immunity to disables while attacking and says nothing about displacement, and needsResearch is empty by design, so nothing was asserted either way. KIT FLAG MISFIRE: olaf.json tags Undertow with grounding; Riot's description is damage plus Armor and Move Speed reduction only, so no grounding claim was written.
